items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I knew the trombone player in the band, his name was Parker Berry.

ctx.x: Clarence Page was playing in the Sterling Hotel and there were no more dances in Sinton Park. I was not old enough to go in the hotel to listen to the music but I knew the trombone player in the band, his name was Parker Berry. Parker had started to play trombone in the kids band of Mr. Ernest Moore at the same time that I had started to play the u,-pa-pa horn. I stopped playing and Barker continued music and became a professional.

Another musician that was playing at the Sterling Hotel was a trumpet player named Harry Morten. Harry had been traveling with his mother in a circus. She was a snake charmer and had come to Cincinnati after quiting a circus. I think that she was born in Cincy but I never knew for certain. Harry was born in Ohio and had played with an orchestra from Columbus, Ohio who were known as the Whispering Serenaders.
